name: brethof-brain
description: Shared long-term memory for your AI agents — auto-recall at session start, auto-archive every turn, and the full memory toolset on demand — through your own Brain hub.

api_key.title: brethof-brain API key
api_key.description: Optional — `brethof-brain pair <hub address>` saves this device's key without it ever passing through your agent. Set it here only to override that.

endpoint.title: Hub address
endpoint.description: Optional — saved by `pair` (default http://127.0.0.1:8600, the hub on this computer).

project.title: Default project
project.description: Optional — default memory project (per-directory mapping still works via ~/.brethof-brain/config.json).
